第1048章 顾清寒见到被红色迷雾包裹着凉亭后的疑惑（第1页）
转眼间凉亭外已然过去一天，而此时凉亭红色迷雾中，已是过去四十万年的时间，那暧昧而酣畅淋漓的鏖战还在持续着。
没过几息后，就听见温清婉，愉悦又颤抖的，急切声音响起道：“对不起！
我不是故意的，你能不能不要恨我？呃..........”
两息后，姬云生的声音，才响起回应道：“好了，别问了，事情都已如此，有什么等后面再说吧！”
话落后，那红色迷雾中再次恢复之前那般，只剩着暧昧而急切的喘息声响起。
随着时间又过去一日后，已然休息好的顾清寒，当她来宫殿外时，
远远就看见整个凉亭，被一团红色迷雾笼罩，仅仅只能模糊看到凉亭轮廓，却看不清凉亭之中的景象。
于此，没一会儿后，顾清寒已然站在凉亭下方，微微抬头看着上方凉亭，疑惑的心里喃喃道：“嗯？师尊这是在干嘛？难道是师尊在修炼，
才让凉亭变成这番景象的吗？可是师尊到底在修炼什么？居然使得凉亭这里，如同又隔出了一方天地，外人压根进不去也看不到里面的情况，所以这到底是为什么呢？难道说师尊修炼的东西，不便让我知道，所以才把这里弄成这样的吗？可若是这样的话，
那我接下来又要干嘛？难不成继续回去修炼？可问题是，就算回去修炼的话，那我也无法使修为再进一步啊！
毕竟我已经达到半步化神极限，再加上这世界的特殊性，我压根就无法感应到雷劫，所以我压根就无法突破化神之境啊！”
顾清寒叹气一口，心里再次喃喃自语道：“唉！
既然师尊在修炼，那我还是回去好了。
只是回去的话，既无法提升修为的话，那么回去练师尊传我的《帝剑》好了。
毕竟这本剑法太难了，自师尊传给我后，我直至现在练第一式的剑招，都无法施展出来，所以还得继续努力。
如若不然的话，万一时间久了，我若还不会这剑法，使得师尊失望了的话，那我该如何面对他呢？”
随后再次盯着上方凉亭几息后，转身就往着宫殿飞去，不再这里打扰姬云生了。

只是当她身影彻底消失离开后，没过多久后，凉亭中那红色迷雾里，
突然响起温清婉，颤抖而急切的声音问道：“刚刚那小丫头是谁？”
紧接着，一息后，语气有些气喘的姬云生回应声响起道：“我的第三个弟子顾清寒，只不过你能别想别的了吗？毕竟如今在干嘛，你难道不清楚吗？唉！
真是服了你了，明明如今在干这种事情，
你还有心情想别的，难道好好享受不好吗？”
这话一出，迷雾之中又再次恢复成，暧昧而急切的喘息声动静了。
随着日子一天天过去，又过去了九天后，只见凉亭恢复成了，没有被红色迷雾包裹的景象。
然而此时，凉亭之中那盖着被子躺在床上的二人，
露着那洁白无瑕的一些后背风光，躺在姬云生身上，并且微微抬起头，与他面对面对视着的，那绝美脸蛋仿佛被水泼湿过的温清婉，满脸幸福的问道：“那你现在可以回答我了吧？”

Chapter 1048 Gu Qinghan’s doubts after seeing the pavilion wrapped in red mist (page 1)
In the blink of an eye, a day has passed outside the pavilion, and in the red mist of the pavilion, 400,000 years have passed, and the ambiguous and hearty battle is still going on.
Not a few breaths later, I heard Wen Qingwan, happy and trembling, urgent voice saying: "I'm sorry!
I didn't mean it, could you please stop hating me? Uh..."
After two breaths, Ji Yunsheng's voice responded: "Okay, don't ask, that's what happened, let's talk about it later!"
After he finished speaking, the red mist returned to the same state as before, with only the vague and urgent breathing sound left.
As time passed and another day passed, Gu Qinghan had already rested. When she came outside the palace,
From a distance, you can see the entire pavilion, shrouded in a red mist. You can only vaguely see the outline of the pavilion, but you can't clearly see the scene inside the pavilion.
At this point, a short while later, Gu Qinghan was already standing under the pavilion, slightly raising his head and looking at the pavilion above, and murmured in doubt: "Huh? What is Master doing? Could it be that Master is practicing?
Did it make the pavilion look like this? But what exactly is Master practicing? It actually makes the pavilion seem like a whole world is separated. Outsiders can't enter or see what's going on inside. So why is this? Could it be that it is inconvenient for me to know what Master cultivates, so that is why this place is like this? But if this is the case,
So what do I do next? Is it possible to continue practicing? But the problem is, even if I go back to practice, I won't be able to improve my cultivation any further!
After all, I have reached the limit of half-step transformation into a god. Coupled with the special nature of this world, I can't sense the thunder tribulation at all, so I can't break through the realm of god transformation at all! "
Gu Qinghan sighed and murmured to himself again: "Alas!
Since Master is cultivating, I'd better go back.
If you can't improve your cultivation if you go back, then I'll go back and practice the "Emperor Sword" passed down to me by my master.
After all, this swordsmanship is too difficult. Since my master passed it on to me, I still can’t perform the first sword move, so I have to keep working hard.
Otherwise, if time passes and I still fail to master this swordsmanship and disappoint the master, then how should I face him? "
Then he stared at the pavilion above for a few seconds, then turned around and flew towards the palace, not to disturb Ji Yunsheng here anymore.
But after her figure completely disappeared and left, not long after, in the red mist in the pavilion,
Suddenly Wen Qingwan asked in a trembling and urgent voice: "Who was that little girl just now?"
Then, after a breath, Ji Yunsheng, who sounded breathless, responded: "My third disciple, Gu Qinghan, can you stop thinking about other things? After all, don't you know what you are doing now? Alas!
I really admire you, you are obviously doing this kind of thing now,
You are still in the mood to think about other things, why not enjoy it? "
As soon as these words came out, the fog returned to normal again, and the ambiguous and urgent breathing became silent.
As the days passed, and nine more days passed, I saw that the pavilion had returned to normal, without being wrapped in the red mist.
However, at this time, the two people lying on the bed covered with quilts in the pavilion,
She lay on Ji Yunsheng with her flawless white back exposed, and raised her head slightly, looking face to face with him. Her beautiful face seemed to have been splashed with water.The wet Wen Qingwan asked with a happy face: "Can you answer me now?"
